comments.comment: Battery life is honestly impressive. I can easily get through a full day of heavy usage without needing to charge.
Camera quality is insane, especially in low light. Night mode actually works instead of making everything look like a blurry mess.

I switched from Android and the smoothness is the first thing I noticed. Apps open instantly and everything feels optimized. That said, I still miss the customization options from Android. Also, my cat knocked the phone off the table yesterday and somehow it survived without a scratch.
Honestly, it's good but feels too similar to the iPhone 13.
The display is bright and clear. Watching videos on this is a great experience, colors look accurate and vibrant.

I bought it mainly for the camera and it didn’t disappoint. Portrait mode is extremely good, especially edge detection. I’ve been using it during my recent trip and every photo looks professional. Also, traveling alone taught me how important it is to enjoy small moments.
Overpriced for what it offers.

Performance is top notch. I play heavy games like Genshin Impact and it runs without lag. The phone barely heats up compared to my previous phone. The only issue is the charging speed could be faster.
My friend recommended it and so far I'm happy with it.
The speakers are surprisingly loud and clear. Watching movies without headphones is actually enjoyable now.
I was sitting in a coffee shop testing the camera and some random guy asked if I was a photographer. That’s how good the camera is. Also the coffee there was terrible, never going back.
Face ID works instantly even in low light.
I like the build quality. It feels premium and durable. I dropped it twice already and nothing happened. Meanwhile my old phone would crack just by looking at the floor.
The weather has been extremely hot lately and honestly that bothers me more than anything about this phone.
Battery health seems stable even after months of usage. Apple really optimized power efficiency well on this model.
It's fast, reliable, and does everything I need.

I upgraded mainly because my old phone was dying constantly. The difference is night and day. Everything is smoother, apps don’t crash, and multitasking is effortless. Also started going to the gym recently and using this phone for tracking workouts.
The design feels boring, but the performance makes up for it.
I spent hours comparing phones before buying this. In the end, I chose it for the ecosystem and reliability. AirDrop and integration with my laptop makes my workflow much easier.
My dog chewed my old phone, so I had no choice but to upgrade. This one is much better though.
